# Cooking Panda

> > Cooking Panda is a culinary destination offering diverse recipes, kitchen equipment guides, and specialty cooking products for home cooks.

Cooking Panda combines a recipe blog with an e-commerce store, featuring cuisines ranging from Thai and Korean to comfort food classics. The site emphasizes both adventurous cooking (spicy dishes, fried appetizers) and practical kitchen guides for equipment selection.

## Key Topics

- Recipe Collection
- Kitchen Tools
- Fried Appetizers
- Comfort Food
- Cooking Equipment
- Food News
- Product Reviews
- Quick Dinners
- Thai Cuisine
- Asian Noodle Soups
- Spicy Dishes
- Kitchen Gadgets
- Home Cooking
- Best Picks
- Cooking Guides

## Core Destinations

- [Cooking Panda's Online Store](https://cookingpanda.com): Cooking Panda's online store homepage featuring featured recipes and products
- [Recipes – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes): Recipe collection hub with desserts, drinks, and cuisine-filtered recipes
- [Shop – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/collections/shop): Product shop featuring seasonings, bundles, and Cooking Panda merchandise

## Appetizer & Fried Food Recipes

- [Super Garlicky Mozzarella Sticks – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/super-garlicky-mozzarella-sticks): Recipe for crispy garlic mozzarella sticks with pork rind coating
- [Red Hot Mac and Cheese Balls – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/red-hot-mac-and-cheese-balls): Spicy deep-fried mac and cheese ball appetizer recipe
- [Deep Fried Stuffed Pickles – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/deep-fried-stuffed-pickles): Beer battered deep-fried stuffed pickles party appetizer recipe

## Soups & Noodle Dishes

- [Thai Mushroom Curry Soup – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/thai-mushroom-curry-soup): Vegetarian Thai mushroom curry soup with aromatic spices
- [Spicy Tortilla Soup – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/spicy-tortilla-soup): Quick Mexican spicy tortilla soup with chicken and enchilada sauce
- [Spicy Cold Pasta with Kimchi – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/spicy-cold-pasta-with-kimchi): Korean-inspired spicy cold pasta with kimchi and sesame oil
- [Shoyu Wonton Noodle Soup – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/shoyu-wonton-noodle-soup): Asian shoyu ramen-inspired wonton noodle soup with seafood
- [Thanksgiving Rice Soup – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/thanksgiving-rice-soup): Warm comfort turkey and rice soup perfect for autumn holidays

## Pasta & Bread Recipes

- [Spicy Pumpkin Vodka Penne – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/spicy-pumpkin-vodka-penne): Fall spicy pumpkin vodka cream sauce penne pasta dinner recipe
- [Olive Bread – Cooking Panda](https://cookingpanda.com/blogs/recipes/olive-bread): Artisan kalamata olive bread recipe with step-by-step instructions
